raw_content:
```yaml
---
id: vuln-braces-abdafb0c
languages:
  - javascript
message: Detected vulnerable usage of braces
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2018-1109
  CWE: CWE-185, CWE-400
pattern:
  metavar: "vulnerable_brace_usage"
  metavar-regex: "^\\{(,+(?:(\\{,+\\})*),*|,*(?:(\\{,+\\})*),+\\}\\}$"
  metavar-regex-taint-mode: "regex"
  metavar-taint-mode: "tainted"
  metavar-regex-taint-mode-regex: "^\\{((?:,|\\{,+\\})+)\\}$"
  metavar-regex-taint-mode-regex-taint-mode: "tainted"
  metavar-regex-taint-mode-regex-taint-mode-regex: "tainted"
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the vulnerable usage of braces in JavaScript code. The pattern field specifies the regular expression that matches the vulnerable usage of braces. The taint-mode field is used to indicate that the pattern is tainted, meaning it can be influenced by user input. The severity field is set to ERROR to indicate that this is a serious issue. The metadata field contains the CVE and CWE numbers for this vulnerability.
